Key Responsibilities:1. Technology Strategy & Architecture
Own the company’s overall technical vision, technology strategy, and architecture across all platforms and products
Define scalable, secure, and reliable technology solutions aligned with business objectives
Drive key architectural and technical decisions, balancing speed, quality, cost, and long-term scalability
Establish and maintain engineering standards covering code quality, security, scalability, and system reliability
Identify and address technical debt, architecture risks, and technology bottlenecks proactively2. Engineering Leadership & Team Development
Lead and develop the engineering leadership team and broader technology organization
Build a high-performance engineering culture focused on quality, ownership, speed, and continuous improvement
Set clear expectations, technical standards, and performance objectives across the engineering function
Develop engineering capabilities, succession plans, and leadership talent to support the company’s growth
Ensure the engineering organization has the right structure, resources, and capabilities to meet business demands3. Platform, Infrastructure & Technical Operations
Own platform uptime, infrastructure scalability, system reliability, and technical operational standards
Ensure systems and infrastructure are designed to support business growth across multiple markets
Establish robust monitoring, incident response, disaster recovery, and business continuity practices
Drive continuous improvements in system performance, scalability, security, and operational efficiency
Evaluate and adopt new technologies, tools, and engineering practices that improve technical capabilities and productivity4. Business & Product Alignment
Partner closely with the executive team, product, and business stakeholders to align technology priorities with company goals
Translate business requirements into practical technical strategies and engineering priorities
Align engineering capacity, resources, and delivery timelines with product and commercial objectives
Provide clear visibility on technology performance, risks, dependencies, and delivery progress
Represent technology strategy, opportunities, and risks to the executive team and Board5. Continuous Improvement & Innovation
Stay current with emerging technologies, engineering practices, and industry trends
Identify opportunities to improve development processes, system capabilities, and engineering efficiency
Promote continuous learning, technical excellence, and knowledge sharing across the technology organization
Drive initiatives that strengthen the company’s competitive advantage through technology
Continuously review and improve the technology roadmap based on business needs, market developments, and organizational priorities
